rows.id: native:[settings Choose translucent or opaque unit path lines.]
rows.source: Choose translucent or opaque unit path lines.
rows.target: अर्धपारदर्शक किंवा अपारदर्शक युनिट पाथ लाईन्स निवडा.

rows.id: native:[settings Smooth the moving edges of progress indicators.]
rows.source: Smooth the moving edges of progress indicators.
rows.target: प्रगती निर्देशकांच्या हलणाऱ्या कडा गुळगुळीत करा.

rows.id: native:[settings Animate victory artwork. Reduced motion also disables this animation.]
rows.source: Animate victory artwork. Reduced motion also disables this animation.
rows.target: विजयाचे कलाचित्र अॅनिमेट करा. गती कमी केल्यास हे अॅनिमेशनदेखील बंद होते.

rows.id: native:[settings Experimental: move and animate units between game ticks.]
rows.source: Experimental: move and animate units between game ticks.
rows.target: प्रायोगिक: गेम टिक्स दरम्यान युनिट्सना हलवा आणि अॅनिमेट करा.

rows.id: native:[settings Fade the map into and out of the fog of war gradually.]
rows.source: Fade the map into and out of the fog of war gradually.
rows.target: नकाशाला युद्धाच्या धुक्यात हळूहळू आणा आणि त्यातून बाहेर काढा.

rows.id: native:[settings Simplify bars, zones, terrain and units as the map zooms out, and keep them small zoomed in.]
rows.source: Simplify bars, zones, terrain and units as the map zooms out, and keep them small zoomed in.
rows.target: नकाशा झूम आउट करताना बार, झोन, भूभाग आणि युनिट्स सोपे करा आणि झूम इन केल्यावर त्यांना लहान ठेवा.

rows.id: native:[settings Enlarge interface text without changing the map scale.]
rows.source: Enlarge interface text without changing the map scale.
rows.target: नकाशाचे प्रमाण न बदलता इंटरफेसवरील मजकूर मोठा करा.

rows.id: native:[settings Choose which server you play on and how you sign in to it.]
rows.source: Choose which server you play on and how you sign in to it.
rows.target: तुम्ही कोणत्या सर्व्हरवर खेळता आणि त्यावर कसे साइन इन करता ते निवडा.

rows.id: native:[settings Could not reach this server.]
native:[settings Download or delete my data]
native:[settings Guests keep a generated name; sign in to choose one.]
rows.source: Guests keep a generated name; sign in to choose one.
rows.target: पाहुणे तयार केलेले नाव ठेवतात; एक नाव निवडण्यासाठी साइन इन करा.

rows.id: native:[settings Opens your account page on %0.]
rows.source: Opens your account page on %0, where you can delete it.
rows.target: %0 वर तुमचे खाते पृष्ठ उघडते, जिथे तुम्ही ते हटवू शकता.

rows.id: native:[settings Run by a community, a club or yourself. Paste its address.]
rows.source: Run by a community, a club or yourself. Paste its address.
rows.target: एखाद्या समुदायाद्वारे, क्लबद्वारे किंवा तुमच्या स्वतःद्वारे चालवले जाते. त्याचा पत्ता लिहा.

rows.id: native:[settings Shown in rooms, matches and the leaderboard. Change once every 30 days.]
rows.source: Shown in rooms, matches and the leaderboard. Change once every 30 days.
rows.target: रूम्स, मॅचेस आणि लीडरबोर्डमध्ये दाखवले जाते. दर ३० दिवसांनी एकदा बदल होतो.

rows.id: native:[settings Sign out on this device]
native:[settings The last sign-in method can't be unlinked.]
rows.source: The last sign-in method can't be unlinked.
rows.target: शेवटची साइन-इन पद्धत वेगळी करता येत नाही.

rows.id: native:[settings The official Globulation 2 server · ranked queues, leaderboards, map catalog]
rows.source: The official Globulation 2 server · ranked queues, leaderboards, map catalog
rows.target: अधिकृत Globulation 2 सर्व्हर · रँक्ड क्यूज, लीडरबोर्ड, मॅप कॅटलॉग

rows.id: native:[settings Unlinking is done on the account page.]
rows.source: Unlinking is done on the account page.

rows.id: native:[settings You'll be a new guest until you sign in again. Your account and matches stay on the server.]
rows.source: You'll be a new guest until you sign in again. Your account and matches stay on the server.
rows.target: तुम्ही पुन्हा साइन इन करेपर्यंत नवीन पाहुणे असाल. तुमचे खाते आणि सामने सर्वरवरच राहतील.

rows.id: native:[settings Open Play online to connect.]
native:[settings Turn off to use classic units, swarms and building colors on this device.]
rows.source: Turn off to use classic units, swarms and building colors on this device.
rows.target: या डिव्हाइसवर क्लासिक युनिट्स, स्वार्म्स आणि बिल्डिंग कलर्स वापरणे बंद करा.

rows.id: native:[settings Command your colony without opening a menu.]
rows.source: Command your colony without opening a menu.
rows.target: मेनू न उघडता आपल्या वसाहतीला आज्ञा द्या.

rows.id: native:[settings Allow supervision for new commands]
native:[settings The commander may follow up on standing orders. Follow-ups use credits; installed orders keep running without credits.]
rows.source: The commander may follow up on standing orders. Follow-ups use credits; installed orders keep running without credits.
rows.target: कमांडर स्थायी आदेशांचा पाठपुरावा करू शकतो. पाठपुराव्यासाठी क्रेडिट्स वापरले जातात; स्थापित आदेश क्रेडिट्सशिवाय चालू राहतात.

rows.id: native:[settings Default shortcuts: Ctrl+Enter to give an order; Ctrl+Shift+Enter to stop commander work. Change them under Controls. Standing-order cards have separate pause and cancel controls.]
rows.source: Default shortcuts: Ctrl+Enter to give an order; Ctrl+Shift+Enter to stop commander work. Change them under Controls. Standing-order cards have separate pause and cancel controls.
rows.target: डीफॉल्ट शॉर्टकट: आदेश देण्यासाठी Ctrl+Enter; कमांडरचे काम थांबवण्यासाठी Ctrl+Shift+Enter. कंट्रोल्स अंतर्गत ते बदला. स्टँडिंग-ऑर्डर कार्डसाठी पॉज आणि कॅन्सल करण्यासाठी स्वतंत्र कंट्रोल्स आहेत.

rows.id: native:[settings Manage credits and purchases in your browser. Commander assistance is permitted in ranked play.]
rows.source: Manage credits and purchases in your browser. Commander assistance is permitted in ranked play.
rows.target: तुमच्या ब्राउझरमध्ये क्रेडिट्स आणि खरेदी व्यवस्थापित करा. रँक्ड प्लेमध्ये कमांडरची मदत घेण्यास परवानगी आहे.

rows.id: native:[settings Record your games as MP4 videos with sound. Recording needs FFmpeg with the libx264 and AAC encoders.]
rows.source: Record your games as MP4 videos with sound. Recording needs FFmpeg with the libx264 and AAC encoders.
rows.target: तुमचे गेम्स आवाजासह MP4 व्हिडिओ म्हणून रेकॉर्ड करा. रेकॉर्डिंगसाठी libx264 आणि AAC एन्कोडरसह FFmpeg आवश्यक आहे.

rows.id: native:[settings Record your games as MP4 videos with sound.]
rows.source: Record your games as MP4 videos with sound.
rows.target: तुमचे गेम्स आवाजासह MP4 व्हिडिओ म्हणून रेकॉर्ड करा.

rows.id: native:[settings Recording uses the full rendered resolution at 30 FPS.]
rows.source: Recording uses the full rendered resolution at 30 FPS.
rows.target: रेकॉर्डिंगमध्ये पूर्ण रेंडर केलेले रिझोल्यूशन ३० FPS वर वापरले जाते.

rows.id: native:[settings FFmpeg is not available, so recording is turned off. Install FFmpeg and make sure it is on your PATH, then check again.]
rows.source: FFmpeg is not available, so recording is turned off. Install FFmpeg and make sure it is on your PATH, then check again.
rows.target: FFmpeg उपलब्ध नाही, त्यामुळे रेकॉर्डिंग बंद केले आहे. FFmpeg इन्स्टॉल करा आणि ते तुमच्या PATH मध्ये असल्याची खात्री करा, त्यानंतर पुन्हा तपासा.

rows.id: native:[settings Hotkey: %0. It also works in menus and the editor.]
rows.source: Hotkey: %0. It also works in menus and the editor.
rows.target: हॉटकी: %0. ही मेन्यू आणि एडिटरमध्ये सुद्धा काम करते.

rows.id: native:[Add JavaScript AIs in Settings → Custom AIs. They appear in each colony’s AI selector.]
rows.source: Add JavaScript AIs in Settings → Custom AIs. They appear in each colony’s AI selector.
rows.target: सेटिंग्ज → कस्टम एआय मध्ये JavaScript एआय जोडा. ते प्रत्येक कॉलनीच्या एआय सिलेक्टरमध्ये दिसतात.

rows.source: Choose Random to select a soundtrack at each match start.
rows.target: प्रत्येक सामन्याच्या सुरुवातीला साउंडट्रॅक निवडण्यासाठी 'Random' निवडा.

rows.id: native:[Sign in through Online settings to like and favourite AIs.]
rows.source: Sign in through Online settings to like and favourite AIs.
rows.target: एआयला लाईक आणि फेव्हरेट करण्यासाठी ऑनलाइन सेटिंग्जमधून साइन इन करा.

rows.id: native:[music Audition each mood for eight seconds]
rows.source: Audition each mood for eight seconds
rows.target: प्रत्येक मूड आठ सेकंदांसाठी आजमावून पहा.
